name: Cyrus Poonawalla

controls.name: Serum Institute of India Pvt. Ltd.
controls.role: Founder (1966) and chairman; privately held under the Cyrus Poonawalla Group; son Adar Poonawalla is CEO

controls.name: Poonawalla Fincorp Ltd.
controls.role: Promoter group holds majority control through Rising Sun Holdings Pvt. Ltd.

stakes.name: Dharma Productions (Karan Johar's film studio), bought by Adar Poonawalla

vehicles.name: Rising Sun Holdings Pvt. Ltd.
vehicles.notes: Promoter vehicle through which the Poonawalla group controls Poonawalla Fincorp.

vehicles.name: Cyrus Poonawalla Group
vehicles.notes: Umbrella group and parent of Serum Institute of India.

privateDeals.what: Adar Poonawalla (Serum Institute CEO) bought a 50% stake in Dharma Productions for about Rs 1,000 crore.

realEstate.area: Mumbai (Breach Candy), India: Lincoln House, the former US consulate building

policy.what: Transfer of Lincoln House, bought in 2015, has been held up for years by ownership disputes involving the US and Indian governments and Maharashtra authorities; in 2023 Poonawalla publicly criticized the government decision blocking it (as of 2023).

Serum Institute makes Covishield (the Oxford-AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine), Covovax (Novavax) and the WHO-recommended R21/Matrix-M malaria vaccine; it supplies vaccines to more than 140 countries, largely through international procurement programs.

giving.name: Villoo Poonawalla Foundation (founded 2011; education, healthcare, water and sanitation; runs a hospital in Pune)
University of Oxford: a vaccines research building is being named after him

watch.what: Poonawalla Fincorp Q2 FY27 results (quarter ending Sept 2026), usually reported in October
Any resolution of the stalled Lincoln House transfer
Serum Institute malaria vaccine (R21) supply and new vaccine approvals

gaps: The session ran out of web searches, so research used direct page fetches only.
